topic: Deep-dive research on the Obsidian plugin obsidian42-BRAT (id obsidian42-brat, author TfTHacker, v2.2.0+, GitHub TfTHacker/obsidian42-brat), for an AI operating the vault at the FILE LAYER. Resolve the exact data.json schema, commands, installation mechanics, file-layer workflows, edge cases, and AI-usage recipes.

main.js and manifest.json are required release assets; styles.css is optional.

keyFindings.text: Themes use root CSS/manifest files and a manifest-name target folder, not GitHub release assets.
Private access requires an already-authorized SecretStorage value; data.json is not sufficient.
An absent incoming styles.css does not cause BRAT to delete an existing one.
GitHub caching can temporarily make a freshly published update unavailable.
